english.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial noun for someone who tells stories to an audience.

examples.english: This storyteller tells stories at the cha chaan teng all the time, and all the neighbours love listening.
examples.traditional: 呢個講故佬成日喺茶記講古，街坊個個都鍾意聽。
